references.text: Repeats the instruction about the seven priests with seven trumpets who are to go before the ark
Describes the fulfillment of the command with the seven priests carrying seven trumpets before the Lord's ark
The fulfillment of marching around the city seven times on the seventh day, and the priests blowing the trumpets
Instructions regarding the use of trumpets by priests for gathering and war, establishing the role of the trumpet in Israel's worship
The jubilee trumpet (shofar) is blown on the Day of Atonement; the same word 'yobel' is used
Trumpet sound as part of a holy assembly, showing the significance of the trumpet in Israelite worship
Gideon uses trumpets in battle, similar to the military use of the shofar for victory
By faith the walls of Jericho fell after the people had marched around them for seven days
